subject: Geopolitics
title: Sanctions as Treaty Alternatives
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Sanctions as Treaty Alternatives.

hook.text: Russia's central bank reserves were frozen in 2022. $300 billion vanished with a keystroke. No treaty required.

buildup.text: Sanctions replace treaties when diplomacy fails. They weaponize finance, trade, and technology access.

discovery.text: The US dollar's dominance makes American sanctions uniquely powerful. Any bank touching dollars obeys US rules.

twist.text: Overuse erodes the tool. Russia, China, and others are building alternative payment systems to escape dollar control.

climax.text: If the dollar loses its sanctions leverage, the US loses its most powerful non-military tool. The stakes are massive.

punchline.text: A weapon used too often teaches enemies to dodge it.

quiz.question: Why are US sanctions especially powerful?
options: Dollar dominance forces any bank touching dollars to comply
The UN automatically backs all US sanctions
